end.summary:
• Discussed what lions, goats, deer, and grass eat.
• Built food chains: grass → deer → tiger; mango leaf → caterpillar; algae → larvae → fish.
• Identified grass as a plant that makes its own food.
• Explained that removing fish leaves the next animal without food, and removing earthworms slows dead-leaf breakdown.
• Animal groups—plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and both—were not completed in teach-back.
end.parentNote: Asha practised food chains, arrow order, and predicting what happens when one part is removed. Manav used the method of asking what each living thing eats and correctly explained several chains and effects. No factual mix-up was recorded, though the animal-group teach-back was not completed. At home, ask Manav to sort a few animals into plant-eaters, meat-eaters, or both and explain one choice.
